Shrouded in Mist#000.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#001.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#001.dst: ベッドの上に薄くほこりが積もっている。

Shrouded in Mist#002.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.
Shrouded in Mist#002.dst: モニターが機械を動かし続けている。

Shrouded in Mist#003.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...
Shrouded in Mist#003.dst: 鋭い物なら壊せるかも…

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: - 記録{~}：一日中家で寝ていた。とても疲れていた。

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#005.dst: - 記録{~}：寝坊。親方の機嫌を損ね、来週は追加の勤務だ。

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: The entries stop after this point...
Shrouded in Mist#008.dst: 記録はここで途切れている…

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: This must be where Nisen lives...
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: ここが Nisen の家に違いない…

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で残りの仲間と合流する。

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#015.dst: 何を？今この状況で何を考えることが―
Shrouded in Mist#015.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#016.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#016.dst: 分かんないよ、Yusanu！次にどうするか、とか？どうやって― ど、どうやって―
Shrouded in Mist#016.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#017.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#017.dst: 何もできやしない！知らない土地で孤立して、家族も仲間もみんな捕まったか、それか― もっと悪い―
Shrouded in Mist#017.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#018.dst: やめて。そんなこと言わないで。
Shrouded in Mist#018.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#019.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#019.dst: くそっ！こんな物を盗む価値があるなんて、あいつに言いくるめられるなんて！盗まなけりゃ…協定も破談にならず、こんなことには―
Shrouded in Mist#019.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: Rex のせいにしないで。あの君主が言ってたでしょ、あいつらは― ず、ずっと前から私たちの計画を知ってたって！
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: …なら、最初から俺たちを巻き込まなきゃよかったんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#023.dst: 侵入者だ！フクロウ隊、構え！

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#026.dst: おっとっとっと！はいはい、みんな一歩下がろうか？

Shrouded in Mist#027.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#027.dst: フクロウ隊！下がれ！いきなり暴力とは飛躍しすぎだ― それは明らかな王家寄りの連中用さ、えへへ。

Shrouded in Mist#028.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#028.dst: 自己紹介させてもらおう！僕は Rurie、樹冠の一員にしてフクロウ隊の隊長さ！手荒な真似は失礼、今日はみんな張り切りすぎでね？
Shrouded in Mist#028.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#030.dst: 質問、質問！残念ながら先にこっちの番だ― フクロウ隊はしばらく下げたが、まだ許されたと思わないことだ、お嬢さん！
Shrouded in Mist#030.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: …隊長、本当によろしいので？こいつら、スパイかもしれませんよ―
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: ちっちっち！手順を信じたまえ、友よ。スパイだろうとなかろうと、情報には価値がある。
Shrouded in Mist#032.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: それに！スパイの…ええと、始末の仕方は心得てるからね。リスクは最小限さ！
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#034.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#034.dst: で…何だ、あんたらも抵抗―
Shrouded in Mist#034.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: そこまでだ、君！聞こえなかったかい？ここではまず僕らが質問するんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: まだ喋ってないのは君だけみたいだね！さあさあ、恥ずかしがらずに。君たちはどこから来たんだい？
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: 本当に？ずいぶん遠くから来たね。あそこからここまで辿り着くのは大仕事だ。
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: ははあ！ピースがはまってきたぞ！分かってきた。
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#039.dst: おほほ？本当かい？実に、実に興味深い。君は「すっごく」賢いスパイか、あるいは…
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: ちょ…ちょっと！聞いて！あなたたちが誰か、な、何者か知らないけど―
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: 何度言わせるんだい？質問は禁止だと―
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: 黙って！私たちは女王を殺そうとして― それでやっと {p} から逃げてきたの！残りの仲間は…捕まったか、し、死んだ！
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: だから― だから放っておいて、じゃないと― 大事な人に二度と、あ、会えなくしてやる！
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#045.dst: ほ、本気だから！！やめ…やめ―
Shrouded in Mist#045.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: おほほ、なかなか気が強いね？
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#047.dst: Rurie…彼女の話なら例の件も―
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#048.dst: ああ友よ、僕もまったく同じことを考えてた。さてさて新入りさん、話が本当なら、樹冠が力になれるかもしれない！
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#049.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#049.dst: 君たちの仲間について、情報があるかもしれない。
Shrouded in Mist#049.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#051.dst: ああ― でも！でもでもでもね― ここ {p} では信頼は通貨なんだ。秘密を一度に全部こぼすわけにはいかないだろう？
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#052.dst: で、僕らの信頼を得たいなら…ちょっと、ええと、片付けてほしいことがある。
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: なに、そう難しくないさ…ただし条件が一つ！人質として一人連れていく！どれにしようかな…君だ、ちびくん！
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#056.dst: そう、君さ！心配無用、ちゃんと無事は保証する。でも…まあ、必要なのは分かるだろう？
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: だめ！もう…もう誰も失えない。お願い、何か別の方法が―
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#058.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#058.dst: Sui…大丈夫だ。選択肢はないと思う。ただ…言われた通りにしてくれ。
Shrouded in Mist#058.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#060.dst: やれやれ、大げさだなあ！ほら、僕は信用できる男だよ！何も心配いらないさ。
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: すん―ばらしい！聞き分けが良くて嬉しいよ。では― 残りの二人には、軍の施設を三つ破壊してきてもらう。
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#063.dst: さあ、お別れを済ませたら、僕のところにリストを取りに来て！
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#064.dst: 出発前に [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Rurie と話す。

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: なあ。お前は大丈夫。俺も大丈夫だ。
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#066.dst: 今は信用していいと思う。どのみち他に道もないしな…
Shrouded in Mist#066.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: 本当に…選択肢はないんだね。私たち、彼らの支援が必要だもん。
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: ただ…Yusanu が無事だといいな。
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: はあ…隊長はいつも通り無茶をする…
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: 心温まるお別れは済んだかな？結構。この寛大な申し出を受けてくれて、本当に嬉しいよ。
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#072.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#072.dst: あっちの小さなお友達は心配いらない！樹冠の中で無事に過ごすさ。
Shrouded in Mist#072.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: …どうやって信じればいいの？彼を…傷つけないって？
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#074.dst: ああ、それこそ核心じゃないか？信じられないさ。でも言ったろう、この森では信頼は貴重だ。それは双方向でなくちゃ！
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: さて新入りさん！破壊してほしい施設のリストは渡したから、簡単な仕事のはずだよ。
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: とにかく…使えなくしてくれ！やり方はどうでもいい― 片付きさえすればね！
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#078.dst: なぜって、絶好の機会だからさ！誰かがやるべき仕事で、君たちは自分を証明する手段が要る…
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#079.dst: なら悪くないだろう？僕の仕事も減るし、文句なしさ！
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: 新入りさん！そうだろう？森にも新入り、世界にも新入り…
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: …もしかして Fruma にも新入りかな？おっと、そんな驚いた顔しないで！君が黙ってれば僕も言わないよ。
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#082.dst: 相変わらず冴えてるね！結構！
Shrouded in Mist#082.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: 終わったらここに戻っておいで！ただし長くかけないでね？退屈しちゃうから！
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#084.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#084.dst: じゃあね、新入りさん！幸運を！それと一つ忠告― 油断しないこと。霧が何を隠してるか分からないからね。
Shrouded in Mist#084.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: チェックリストで破壊する施設を選ぶ。

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: まだ迷ってる？クエストブックで壊してほしい物を探せばいいよ！
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#087.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の見張り塔へ行き、呪文で破壊する。

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: じゃあここが…その場所？「軍用…見張り塔…」たぶんね。
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: あの支柱、かなりぐらついて見えるよね？もしかして…
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: お、お願い、あれを何とかして？
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: 何っ？！襲撃だ― 樹冠の連中に違いない！
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: さっさと終わらせよう。
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#095.dst: 本を見て、次はどこに行けばいい？
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#097.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.
Shrouded in Mist#097.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の揚水ポンプへ行き、破壊する。

Shrouded in Mist#099.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#099.dst: これは協力できそう。あなたは、えっと、構造の弱い所を撃ち抜いて。私は…水の流れを逆にできないか試してみる。
Shrouded in Mist#099.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#100.dst: この…ガラクタを片付けちゃおう。
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#101.dst: あなたは、えっと、魔法で弱い所をいくつか撃ち抜いてみて。
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: パイプに圧はかけられた？
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#103.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#103.dst: よし、じゃあ…私の番、かな。えっと、準備ができたら声をかけて。
Shrouded in Mist#103.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#105.dst: 大丈夫…大丈夫。息をして。集中…しなきゃ。
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: あの…あんなことが、えっと、色々あってから、ずっと…自分の呪…うう。分かるでしょ。
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#107.dst: 何もかもが…すごく…絶望的で！みんなを失って、今度は― 今度は Yusanu まで失って、私…私、何もできなかった！
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: しかも最後にしたのが…口喧嘩！今あいつは…たぶん無事だけど、でも…分からない。喧嘩しなきゃよかった。
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#109.dst: 考えるたびに― 何を考えても、すごく…腹が立つの！そしたら周りの渦巻く海がどんどん荒れ狂って、それで…それで…
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: 怖いよ、{u}。Mora が…Syndra が…Rex、Zeph、鋼の羽根のみんなが― みんなが心配で！なのに私…何もできない…
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: もし…もしみんないなくなってたら？そしたら、そしたら、ずっと私たちだけ…？
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: わ…分かってる、{u}、分かってるよ！が…頑張ってるってば！
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: もう、はは、何も残ってないかも。何もかも…速すぎて…
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: 私…こんなこと望んでなかった。ただ…ただ生きたかっただけなのに…
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: はあ…よし。Sui、集中。あなたならできる。
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: あの…海が…止まった。引っぱったら…動かなくなって…
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: 今は…考えてる暇はない。うまくいったんだから…それでいい。
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: とにかく…本を見て、次の目的地は？
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#123.dst: た…たぶん今ので最後。Rurie に、えっと、終わったって伝えに行こう。
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#125.dst: あれが…間違いなくドリルだね。
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: 頑丈…そう。えっと、そう簡単には…壊せなさそう。別の方法を探さなきゃ…
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: こ、この近くには水がないの。だから、もし兵士が来たら…お願い、相手してくれる？
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: はっ、破壊工作員め！王家の財産を傷つけて逃げられると思うな、私の目の黒いうちはな！
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#129.dst: えっと…お見事、{u}。操作盤を壊すなんて思いつかなかった…
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#130.dst: 本を見て、次の目的地を探そう。
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: 今ので最後？Rurie の所に戻って…終わったって伝えよう。
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Rurie の所へ戻り、次の段取りを話し合う。

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: さてさて！新入りさんのお帰りだ！で、試練はどうだった？
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: 言われた通りにやった。だから…早く仲間のことを教えて！
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#135.dst: ちっちっち！そう急がない！残念ながら、まだ終わりじゃないんだ！
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: 残念ながら大真面目さ！あれはね、諸君、任務の第一段階にすぎないんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: いやいや、その逆さ！君たちがやり遂げた瞬間に知らせが届いたよ。
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: もう…約束したじゃない！そんな勝手に―
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: できるさ。僕らの支援が欲しいなら、言うことを聞くんだ。慰めになるなら、取引が終わる前の頼みはこれが最後だよ。
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: 君たちには、その…{p} の住民を一人、ここへ運んできてほしい。誰にも見られないようにね！色々と…面倒になるから。
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#143.dst: そ…その人、私たちが来るの知ってるの？
Shrouded in Mist#143.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#144.dst: おっと！言い直そう。誘拐してきてほしいんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#146.dst: そう、その通り！さらって、ここへ連れてくる。後はこっちで処理するよ。
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: つまり…適当な住民を家から連れ去れってこと？それに、それに「後は処理する」ってどういう意味？
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#148.dst: 質問はなしだよ、お嬢さん！お友達の無事を確かなものにしたいならね。
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#150.dst: そもそも誰を探せばいいのかも聞いてない！
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: あはは、失敬、僕のミスだ！探すのは Nisen という男だよ。ここへ連れてきて、でも長くかけないでね！
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: Nisen。分かった。{u}、この話は…洞窟の外でしよう。
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: 洞窟を出て、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Sui と作戦を話し合う。

Shrouded in Mist#154.dst: さあさあ急いで！待ってるよ。
Shrouded in Mist#154.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: 何とか Yusanu を取り戻して…ここから逃げる方法を見つけないと。
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: 分かってる、分かってるってば！探し始めたら、あいつらに、き、気づかれる。
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: あの道化の言いなりは…もううんざり。でも、あなたの言う通り…
Shrouded in Mist#158.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#159.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#159.dst: ただ…変なの。この最後の任務。意味が分からない。
Shrouded in Mist#159.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#160.dst: Rurie がいくらイカれてても…罪のない人をあっさり― あっさり殺すとは思えない。まして、えっと、抵抗組織なんだし。
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: うう。分かんない。Nisen って人を調べれば…Rurie の狙いが分かるかも。
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} へ行き、Nisen を探し出す。

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: ふう。ここまで登るのは楽じゃなかった…Auburn の Red Fox なんて、はは、比べ物にならない。
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: Nisen のことを聞いて回ってるんだけど…みんな私をあまり好きじゃないみたい。
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#167.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#167.dst: あなたなら上手くいくかも？
Shrouded in Mist#167.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#182.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#182.dst: …見…えない。君は持ってない― あっ。い、いや。何でもない。うん。絶対、その…絶対ない。
Shrouded in Mist#182.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#183.dst: 見ちゃだめだ、君と話すことすら許されてないのに、それに― 待って、今のも数に入る、うわあ！
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#184.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#184.dst: …僕。僕は。君。…うう、こういうの苦手なんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#184.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#185.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#185.dst: …その。…ごめん。Nisen…僕。知ってるよ。言っちゃいけないけど、知ってる。お願い、痛いことしないで。
Shrouded in Mist#185.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#186.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#186.dst: 北西へ行くジップラインに乗って。でも上に行く方じゃないよ。
Shrouded in Mist#186.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#187.dst: …そんな…そんなに近くで見ないで。
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Nisen の家を調べ、手がかりを探す。

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: えっと、留守だといいけど…
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#192.dst: 変ね…最後の記録は何週間も前の日付だ。
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#193.dst: 急に書くのをやめたみたい…
Shrouded in Mist#193.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#194.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Nisen の家から急いで出る。

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#196.dst: ひっ！Nisen だ！言い訳を考えなきゃ…
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: 失礼？私の住まいで何をしている？
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#198.dst: 私の記憶違いでなければ、他人の住まいに迷い込むのは慣習ではない。
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#199.dst: あっ…す、すみません！わ、私たち― ここが…パン屋だと思って。
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: ああ。そう、建物違いだ。パン屋は下の地上階にある。
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#202.dst: あっ！道を教えてくれてありがとう。勘違いして…本当にすみません。
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の中央広場で Sui と合流する。

Shrouded in Mist#204.dst: 頼むから、もう出ていってくれ。
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#205.dst: 危なかった…えっと、よく信じてくれたね。
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#206.dst: パ、パニクったの！でもうまくいったでしょ？
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: あの人…意外とよく喋ったね。他の人たちと比べたら新鮮。
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: でも、えっと、ちょっと…変だった。答えに自信がなさそうで…
Shrouded in Mist#208.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#209.dst: 分かんない。あなたはどう思う？何か仮説ある？
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: 私も…同じことを考えてた。それなら日記が急に途切れたのも説明がつく…
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: かも…ありえるかな。私の早とちりかもしれないけど。
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: えっと…それはもう少し練ろうか。
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: 見て、ベッド脇の机から予定表をくすねてきたの。
Shrouded in Mist#213.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: 聞いて。「正午、武器屋の狩猟道具を南口から搬出」
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: 変でしょ？あの人、絶対何かおかしい…でもだからって、さらってどこかの…どこかの鳥男に渡すなんて！嫌だよ。
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: でも…選択肢はほとんどない。南門の外で待ち伏せしよう…
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Nisen を誘拐する準備をする。

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#221.dst: 私…はは、ここに来てからずっと手に負えないって感じてる。こんなに色々、その…みんなの支えなしでやったことなかった。
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#222.dst: でも…あなたが手伝ってくれてるから。えっと。一緒にいてくれて、あ、ありがとう。あなたがいなきゃ、ここまで来られなかった。
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#225.dst: いたた…馬鹿なことした…
Shrouded in Mist#225.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#226.dst: えっと…でもうまくいったみたい。手伝ってくれる？
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#228.dst: 思ってたより…簡単だった。
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#229.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#229.dst: なんていうか、えっと、上に落っこちた？それで…こうなったの。
Shrouded in Mist#229.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#230.dst: そろそろ…移動した方がいいかも。誰にも― 誰にも見られたくない！
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: えっと！操ったっていうのは…ちょっと違うかも。私…はは、凍らせようとしたの。だから…まだ練習中。たぶん。
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#233.dst: えっと！私…考えてなかった。
Shrouded in Mist#233.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: やあやあ、新入りさん！手を貸そうか！
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: わっ！ど、どこから出てきたの？！
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: もちろん木の上からさ！善良なる Nisen 氏を取り押さえたようだね、お見事、お見事。
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#237.dst: …言われたことは全部やった。さあ― さあ知ってることを話して！！
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: おやおや、これで終わりだと思った？はっ！あはははは！
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#240.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#240.dst: 冗談！冗談だってば― いやあ、その顔！友達同士のちょっとしたイタズラじゃないか、ねえ？
Shrouded in Mist#240.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: 分かった分かった！まったく、お嬢さん…
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: 冗談は…ひとまずやめよう。朗報だ！テストは合格さ！
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#244.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#244.dst: はいはい、落ち着いて、話すから。ちょっと待ってよ！まったく。せっかちだねえ？
Shrouded in Mist#244.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: 二人を樹冠へ案内しよう！ただ、ああ、ちょっとした用心で― 着くまで目隠しさせてもらうよ、安全対策さ！
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#246.dst: はあ…もう、どうでもいい。とにかく…Yusanu の所へ連れてって。
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: パーフェクト！では出発だ！
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#248.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#248.dst: はあ！分かった分かった！でも急いで。
Shrouded in Mist#248.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Rurie、説明してもらえますか？なぜこの部外者たちを連れてきたのです？
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#251.dst: いやあ、分かるだろう Fuhue！今朝の巡回が退屈でさ！君たちってあんまり場を盛り上げてくれないし…
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#252.dst: Azael が勧誘に明確な規則を定めているのは知っているでしょう。必要な書類は提出しましたか？私の机には何も届いていませんが。
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#253.dst: その…ああ、書類って本当にあったの？君が面白半分に作った話だと思ってた。
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: 違います。規程には理由があるのです、Rurie 隊長。自分で目を通す時間を作りますか、それとも Cileon 隊長に説明させましょうか？
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#255.dst: はいはい、大切さは分かってるよ― でも Cileon も規程については僕と同意見のはずだ。そうだろう、Cileon？
Shrouded in Mist#255.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: くだらん。足場から落とせ。
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#257.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#257.dst: ちょ、ちょっと！私たちが目の前にいないみたいに話さないで！
Shrouded in Mist#257.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: Cileon！それも規程違反です。王家に死体を見つけさせるわけにはいきません、もっと簡単な処分方法があるのです。
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: それにもちろん、まずは必要な情報を拷問で吐かせないと― もう何十回も聞いたよ。
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: まあ！ちゃんと聞いていたのですね！よろしい、Rurie 隊長。いずれ分別を叩き込んであげます。
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#261.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#261.dst: Nisen は先ほど子鹿たちに処理室へ運ばせました。ご苦労さまでした、隊長。
Shrouded in Mist#261.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: ああ、お安い御用さ！汗ひとつかいてないよ！
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: じゃ、また後で！規程に従うなら、この子たちを Azael に引き渡さなきゃいけないんだろうね。
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: やあやあ、友よ！ちょっと喉が渇いたから、ここで失礼するよ！Azael は自分たちで探せるよね？
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の樹冠の中で指導者を探す。

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: ん。Rurie が Azael を探せと。
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#275.dst: 予定はいつも詰まっているのに…さらに仕事が増えました。
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#276.dst: とはいえ、質問に答える時間くらいは作れるでしょう。
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#277.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#277.dst: 私は Fuhue、シカ隊の隊長です。
Shrouded in Mist#277.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#278.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#278.dst: シカ隊の業務だけでなく、樹冠全体の管理も担っています。
Shrouded in Mist#278.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#279.dst: Azael 様は小屋にいらっしゃいます…ここのすぐ南西です。
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: 聞いた話では、お友達もそちらにいるそうですよ。
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: 残念ながら。相変わらず手に負えません…
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: ですが自分の仕事にかけては比類なき才能です。彼ほどフクロウ隊を率いられる者はいません。
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: あるいは会えないかも！あなた方が残れるかは Azael 様が決めます。感心させられるといいですね。
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#285.dst: {p} でのこれまでの活躍は聞いている。実に見事な働きだ。
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: 話を遮ってすみませんが、一日中走り回って疲れてるんです。Yusanu はどこ？
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: よかった、無事で…本当によかった。
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: ああ、ようやくの再会だ。だが揃ったからには、本題に入ろう。
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: {p} での君たちの活躍は Yusanu から聞いた。
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#292.dst: そして我々の大義は一致しているようだ…王家の打倒という点で。我々樹冠は、そのために積極的に動いてきた。
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#293.dst: 我々は三つの隊を設け、それぞれに役目を与えた。各隊が異なる戦線で王家を攻める。
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#294.dst: フクロウ隊は我らの目と耳だ。最も有能な暗殺者たちでもある。既に会った Rurie 隊長は、我らでも屈指の危険な者だ。
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: キツネ隊は突撃部隊だ。{p} 古来の技を使う熟練の剣士たちで、決闘で決して負けぬよう鍛えられている。
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.dst: シカ隊は指揮部隊、作戦の頭脳だ。そして…{p} に潜むスパイの始末も担っている。
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: スパイだ。君たちが連れてきた男、Nisen…もはや Nisen ではないだろう。数週間前、王家の精鋭スパイと入れ替わっていた。我々はそれをチェンジリングと呼ぶ。
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: {p} は長年、この変装の達人どもに苦しめられてきた。正体を見破れば、捕らえて尋問のため拘束している。
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: この地の人々は身元を示す手段を生み出した。メダリオンだ。持っていなければ、多くの者は口を利いてくれまい。
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: あの…Azael さん、失礼なつもりはないんですけど…Rurie が、Roughworks の仲間の情報があるって言ってたんです。
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#302.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#302.dst: ある意味ではな。だがフクロウ隊が祭りから持ち帰った情報を、まだ精査している最中だ。今はまだ何も伝えられない。
Shrouded in Mist#302.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: 安心してくれ、すべて確認し終えたら、何一つ隠しはしない。
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: 君たちの仲間の消息を探し続けると約束しよう。
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: やっと…やっと一息つける気がする。
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: 私は Yusanu と一緒に、情報の整理が終わるのを待つね。
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: 俺はこの装置が何に使うものか調べることに集中するよ。
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: 盗む価値はあったはず…きっと、何かしら。
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#004~1.src: Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?
Shrouded in Mist#004~1.dst: 君主 Zhiraok に再挑戦する？
